Yosemite Essentials What to Expect in Fall Tioga Road and Glacier Point Road typically close for the winter sometime in November. Closing dates depend on the arrival of winter conditions. When Tioga Road is closed, there is NO access to or from the east side of Yosemite (Hwy 120 to the east, Hwy 395.) Call 209/372-0200 (press 1, then 1) to hear the current road status. Tire chains may be required on park roads. Expect chain restrictions on park roads from November to March, especially during or after winter storms. When restrictions are in effect, ALL vehicles must carry chains, including 4-wheel drive and rental vehicles. Call 209/372-0200 (1, 1) to hear current road conditions. Visit go.nps.gov/chains to learn about tire chains. Expect reduced visitor services this time of year. Information centers

Waterfalls may be very low or completely dry. Waterfalls peak during spring snowmelt and may be only a trickle or dry by fall. It’s fire season in Yosemite. Smoke from wildfires inside or outside the park may affect visibility and can pose a health concern, especially for sensitive individuals. Fires are only allowed in portable stoves, barbecue grills, and established fire rings. Never leave a fire unattended—extinguish the fire completely before you leave it.
